gauntlet: question
The ticket repair is saved and re-extracted. acme/widgets#77 now reads "The report-view setting uses the shared settings resolver." I'm keeping that row `in-scope` as written, with the default owned at settings/resolver.ts:12 and read at ui/report-view.ts:30.

The open behavior is what happens to active report filters when the user switches workspaces. Which outcome should the setting deliver?

A) Always reset: filters return to resolver defaults on every workspace change, and the setting only supplies those defaults.
B) Configurable reset, default on: the setting chooses between resetting and keeping filters on a workspace change, defaulting to reset.
C) Keep but prune: filters carry over, and any filter value that doesn't exist in the new workspace is dropped, so rows aren't hidden.
D) other - name it

Recommendation: B - the ask is a report-view setting, so the setting should control the reset itself. Defaulting to reset fixes the reported hidden-rows bug through the resolver path that already owns defaults.

What should the new setting allow users to choose when switching workspaces?
A) Clear active report filters on each switch.
B) Preserve active report filters across switches.
C) Restore each workspace’s last-used report filters.
D) other - name it.
Recommendation: A - clearing filters addresses hidden rows in the new workspace without adding per-workspace filter storage.
